serial_lane._modes: exclusive_after_parallel (default, safest): serial lane starts only after every parallel worker has exited. No other mode is implemented on purpose.

vitest.estimated_seconds_source: assumption (no timing evidence exists for the frontend suite)

retry_policy: none (failures are never retried or hidden)

db._note: Host as seen FROM the php container (DEV compose service name, verified via docker ps). .env.testing says 127.0.0.1, which is only valid from the DB container itself; the existing Codex/agent procedure overrides DB_HOST the same way.

php._modes: docker-exec | host. docker-exec: runs `docker exec` in the EXISTING container (never starts one). Paths are mapped host backend/ -> container_backend (only backend/ is mounted).

node._modes: docker-run only. Linux node_modules are prepared separately (`prepare-frontend`, Owner) and mounted over /work/node_modules; the host (darwin) node_modules is never executed in the container.

exit_codes.1: FAIL (test or worker failure) / static-validation or inventory mismatch
exit_codes.2: REFUSED: usage, Owner gate or preflight refusal — nothing was started
exit_codes.4: BLOCKED: worker/process termination could not be verified; artifacts kept, nothing further was started
